name: rdSetRenderOptions
comment: Sets g_dwRdroid_curRenderOptions (bit 1: apply camera fog/attenuation at +0x54)

name: rdSetGeometryMode
comment: Upper limit for the per-mesh geometry mode (0 none .. 4 textured)

name: rdSetSortingMethod
comment: 2 = qsort the cached mesh list by depth before drawing

name: rdSetOcclusionMethod
comment: 0 selects the plain software path in rdCache_Flush

name: rdSetZBufferMethod
comment: 2 selects the z-buffered software path (rdCache_DrawFaceZ)

name: rdAdvanceFrame
comment: Resets the caches, bumps the frame counter, clears the canvas and begins the 3D scene

name: rdFinishFrame
comment: Flushes the mesh cache, ends the 3D scene and dumps the memory log

name: rdCache_Reset
comment: Empties the 1024-entry mesh list (0x78 bytes each at g_RdCacheMeshes) and the vertex/uv/colour pools

name: rdCache_GetProcEntry
comment: Returns the next free cached-mesh record, flushing first when the list or a 0x8000-entry pool is full

name: rdCache_Flush
comment: Sorts (sort mode 2) and draws every cached mesh with the software or 3D path chosen by the occlusion/zbuffer modes

name: rdCache_AddProcFace
proto: int rdCache_AddProcFace(void * mesh, uint vertexCount, byte flags)
comment: Appends a mesh to the cache list and computes its screen bounds / depth

name: rdCache_SendFaceListToHardware
comment: Direct3D path: uploads the material textures (rdMaterial_AddToTextureCache) and batches the cached meshes into execute buffers

name: rdCache_DrawFaceN
proto: int rdCache_DrawFaceN(void * mesh)
comment: Software path without z-buffer: clamps the mesh modes to the global limits and calls the rasterizer entry for each face

name: rdCache_DrawFaceZ
proto: int rdCache_DrawFaceZ(void * mesh)
comment: Software path with z-buffer

name: rdCamera_AddLight
proto: int rdCamera_AddLight(void * camera, void * light, float * position)
comment: Up to 64 lights per camera; stores the light pointer and position and precomputes the falloff terms

name: rdModel3_Draw
proto: int rdModel3_Draw(void * thing, float * position)
comment: Rdthing.c: frustum-tests the model's bounding sphere, picks the geometry set, updates the puppet and draws the node hierarchy

name: rdModel3_DrawHNode
comment: Recursive hierarchy walk (+0x58 child count, +0x5c first child, +0x60 sibling) drawing each node's mesh

name: rdModel3_DrawMeshImpl
proto: void rdModel3_DrawMeshImpl(void * mesh, float * matrix)

name: rdPrimit3_DrawLine
comment: Clips a world-space segment against the camera frustum, projects it and draws it with rdCanvas_DrawLine

name: rdPrimit3_DrawPoint
comment: Projects a world-space point with a radius and draws it as a 2D point

name: rdPrimit3_ClipFace
comment: Clips one face against the frustum; the switch selects the vertex attribute set from the geometry/lighting modes

name: rdPrimit3_NoClipFace
comment: Copies the face's vertex attributes (position, uv, intensity) into the cache pools without clipping

name: rdAFRaster_CalcAffineGradients
comment: Finds the top/bottom vertices of a screen polygon and the attribute gradients (plane equations) for the span fillers

name: rdAFRaster_CalcPerspGradients
comment: rdAFRaster_CalcAffineGradients variant that also computes the texture coordinate gradients

name: rdAFRaster_DrawSpanNGonLW_8
comment: Wireframe span: plots only the two end pixels

name: rdMaterial_RegisterLoader
comment: Installs the engine's material loader callback and returns the previous one

name: rdMaterial_LoadEntry
proto: int rdMaterial_LoadEntry(char * filename, void * material, int a, int b)
comment: Reads a 'MAT ' material file: header, colour table, per-cel texture surfaces (type 2 colour-keyed / type 0 solid)

name: rdMaterial_FreeEntry
comment: Frees the cel bitmaps, their mip surfaces and Direct3D textures

name: rdMaterial_AddToTextureCache
proto: int rdMaterial_AddToTextureCache(void * a, uint * material, int cel, int alt)
comment: Touches the cel's Direct3D texture or creates it (std3D_AddToTextureCache) on first use

name: rdNRaster_DrawNGonLV
comment: Plots each vertex of the polygon as one pixel (8 and 16 bpp)

name: rdNRaster_DrawNGonLW
comment: Draws the polygon edges with rdCanvas_DrawLine

name: rdClip_Line2
comment: Cohen-Sutherland line clip against a rectangle using rdClip_CalcOutcode2

name: rdClip_Point3
proto: int rdClip_Point3(void * frustum, float * point)
comment: Near/far, then left/right/top/bottom; perspective frustums scale the side planes by depth

name: rdClip_Line3
proto: int rdClip_Line3(void * frustum, float * p0, float * p1, int * clipped0, int * clipped1)

name: rdClip_Face3W
comment: Frustum clip of a face with position-only vertices (output into the rdClip work buffers at g_RdClipVerts). Attribute set inferred from the parameter list

name: rdClip_Face3WOrtho
comment: Second position-only face clipper (likely the orthographic variant)

name: rdClip_Face3GS
comment: Face clipper interpolating position, texture coordinate and intensity

name: rdMatrix_BuildTranslate34
proto: void rdMatrix_BuildTranslate34(float * m, float * pos)
comment: Identity 3x4 (from g_flRdroid_identMatrix34) with the translation column set

name: rdMatrix_Multiply34
proto: void rdMatrix_Multiply34(float * out, float * a, float * b)
comment: 3x4 affine matrix product

name: rdMatrix_PreMultiply34
proto: void rdMatrix_PreMultiply34(float * m, float * angles)
comment: Rotation 3x4 from pitch/yaw/roll angles in degrees

name: Matrix_BuildTransform
comment: Rotation then translation

name: rdMatrix_TransformPointLst34
proto: void rdMatrix_TransformPointLst34(float * m, float * in, float * out, int count)

name: rdPuppet_NewEntry
proto: int rdPuppet_NewEntry(void * puppet, void * thing)
comment: Six tracks of 0x134 bytes starting at +8; all stopped

name: rdPuppet_AddTrack
proto: uint rdPuppet_AddTrack(void * puppet, uint keyframe, uint lowPri, uint highPri)
comment: Takes the first free track (status 0) and binds the keyframe to it

name: rdPuppet_SetCallback
comment: Writes the last dword (+0x12c) of the track record

name: rdPuppet_PlayTrack
comment: Status bits: clears 0x10, sets 2, speed 1.0

name: rdPuppet_FadeInTrack
proto: int rdPuppet_FadeInTrack(void * puppet, int track, float seconds)

name: rdPuppet_FadeOutTrack
proto: int rdPuppet_FadeOutTrack(void * puppet, int track, float seconds)

name: rdPuppet_AdvanceTrack
proto: void rdPuppet_AdvanceTrack(void * puppet, int track, float dt)
comment: Advances the track time, handles fades and loops, stops finished tracks

name: rdPuppet_ResetTrack
comment: Zeroes the 64 node weights of a track and marks it status 3

name: rdLight_NewEntry
comment: Defaults: type 2, on, white (0xffffff), intensity 1.0

name: rdLight_CalcVertexIntensities
comment: Accumulates the intensity of every light (type, radius, direction) at each vertex position

name: rdCanvas_DrawLine
proto: void rdCanvas_DrawLine(void * canvas, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, ushort color, uint pattern)
comment: Bresenham line, 8 and 16 bpp, with a 32-bit stipple pattern

name: rdCanvas_DrawPoint
comment: Clips a point with radius against the canvas rect and draws it

name: rdThing_NewEntry
comment: Default thing: geometry mode 4, lighting 3, texture 2, no model, both sprite indices -1

name: rdThing_FreeEntry
comment: Type 1 (model) things free their puppet buffers

name: rdThing_SetSprite
comment: Thing type 2 pointing at a sprite

name: rdThing_SetPolyline
comment: Thing type 4 pointing at a polyline

name: rdThing_AccumulateMatrices
comment: Node matrix = node pivot/offset transform times the parent's matrix

name: rdPolyline_DrawFace
comment: Allocates a cache mesh for one polyline face, clips and adds it

name: rdSprite_DrawThing
proto: int rdSprite_DrawThing(void * thing, void * sprite)
comment: Billboard: builds a camera-facing matrix for the thing position and draws the sprite

name: rdSprite_New
comment: Allocates a 0xb8-byte polyline (RDroid Primitiv*.c) and initialises it

name: rdSprite_NewEntry
comment: Copies the 31-char name and builds the vertex ring for the given radius/segment counts

name: rdSprite_Draw
comment: Frustum tests the sprite, builds the quad in the cache and clips it

name: stdDisplay_BuildBitmapInfo8
comment: Fills a BITMAPINFO (0x28 header, negative height) with a 256-entry palette

name: Palette_SwapRedBlue
comment: Converts a 768-byte RGB palette to BGR order
